Scope

What’s included

  • UX/UI and interactive prototypesBefore any code is written, we review page structure and user journeys together in a prototype.
  • Frontend, backend and CMSThe interface, the server side and, where needed, a CMS so you can manage content yourself.
  • SEO foundations and launchWe launch with proper headings, metadata, a sitemap and technical setup.

Process

How we work

  1. 01

    Discovery

    We study your goals, audience and existing processes, then define scope and priorities.

    OUTPUT / A clear project brief
  2. 02

    Design

    User journeys, interfaces and technical architecture. We review the solution together before writing code.

    OUTPUT / Design and project plan
  3. 03

    Development

    We build iteratively, demonstrate progress and collect your feedback at each step.

    OUTPUT / A tested product
  4. 04

    Launch

    Final checks, deployment and handover. Further development is agreed separately.

    OUTPUT / A launch-ready solution

Questions

Questions

Will we be able to edit the site ourselves?+

Yes, if you need to. Connecting a CMS so you can manage content is agreed in the scope up front.

How is a project priced?+

We prepare a proposal after defining scope, integrations and requirements. Price and deliverables are agreed before work begins.

Can I get in touch with just an idea?+

Absolutely. Our first conversation turns your idea into user needs, core features and a first delivery stage.

Can you improve an existing system?+

Yes. We first review the code and architecture, then propose improvements or integrations.

How long does a project take?+

Timelines depend on scope. After the brief, we agree on milestones, acceptance criteria and a delivery plan.
